about: Every command Fasteners Workbench registers (Gui.addCommand in its source), judged: tool (an agent does it headless through the Fasteners bridge or Agent Link), window (only in its window), n/a (nothing to do). Like Agent Link's coverage audit.

Fasteners_3dPrintSettings.why: Reads and sets its 3D-print thread settings (FSParam) and redoes threaded fasteners, as its panel's Update does.

Fasteners_ChangeParameters.why: Type, size (Auto), length (nearest standard, FindClosest), match, as its Change Parameters panel's OK does.

Fasteners_Search.why: Searches its type table (FSScrewCommandTable) by words, standard and kind.

Fasteners_Move.why: BaseObject set to another round edge.

Fasteners_Simplify.why: A plain non-parametric copy of the shape; Agent Link's element copy does the same for any object.

Fasteners_RestoreProperties.why: Its proxy given back to fasteners saved where it was not loaded (FSScrewObject).

Fasteners_MatchTypeInner.why: Its toolbar toggle sets a default; the tools take match per call.

Fasteners_BOM.why: Its own Generate BOM runs in the window; headless the same Type/Qty sheet is written.

Fasteners_ScrewCalculator.why: Metric, inch and BSP tap holes from ScrewMaker's charts (headless). Its PEM press-nut, stand-off, stud and EJOT charts live in FSScrewCalc.py, which imports Qt at its top: those stay in its window.

FS<type>.why: One Add command per type in FastenersCmd.FSScrewCommandTable (FSAddScrewCommand: 'FS' + type); fastener_add makes the same FSScrewObject, on edges or loose. The live echo lights FS<type> (command_for).

<group dropdown>.why: With ScrewToolbarGroupMode 2 its toolbar groups the FS<type> commands under dropdowns named by group (FSGroupCommand); each holds commands judged above.

notWindowCommands.CountersunkHoles: No command any more: its countersunk-hole objects are deprecated by Fasteners itself (use PartDesign Hole, or Workshop's hw_hole countersink); old files still recompute.
notWindowCommands.Preferences page (FSprefs.ui): Toolbar and default-colour preferences: window only, nothing an agent needs.
